wholePhysicalScope: Native building way and mapped parts identify the projecting steeple and gabled nave. The National Park Service describes the curve around the tower on Church Street.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain all three porticoes and the tapering octagonal steeple.
limitations: The standing church, porticoes and steeple. Adjacent Good Shepherd Chapel, churchyard and interior lie outside scope.
The steeple uses the mapped height, and intermediate heights and ornament are estimated.
